name: agent-polyfill
description: MCP extensions for hosts that haven't shipped them yet: the GitHub Copilot CLI plugins

plugins.name: mcp-events
plugins.description: MCP Events (SEP-3415): Copilot can watch events on your MCP servers (poll, push or webhook) and act when one fires, even while the session sits idle. Needs Copilot's experimental mode.

plugins.name: mcp-tasks
plugins.description: MCP Tasks (SEP-2663): start long-running tools, follow their progress and answer task questions in an interactive Copilot terminal.

plugins.name: mcp-server-cards
plugins.description: MCP Server Cards (SEP-2127): Copilot finds the MCP servers a domain publishes, checks their Server Cards, and adds one to its configuration once you approve it in a form

plugins.name: ard-discovery
plugins.description: Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD v0.91, a draft outside MCP): find MCP servers through a domain's ard.json or by searching an ARD registry (each search asks you first), and add one once you approve it
